department.title: Toy Division
department.arrival_prompt: Elevator doors opening onto a cheerful toy workshop floor deep underground, rows of plush teddy bears riding conveyor belts, pastel balloons tied to heavy blast doors, a padded test range glowing under floodlights in the distance, mid-century safety-manual illustration, screen-printed gouache with halftone grain, limited palette of manila, carbon-paper blue, safety orange, fluorescent-tube green and oxblood, horizontal 4:3 composition, every surface bare and unmarked

locations.title: Concept Lab
locations.description: A bright workshop of crayon sketches and blueprint margins. Every prototype has a smile and a payload, and every idea is written down by a man from Defense.

locations.title: Focus Group Room
locations.description: Beanbags, a bowl of fruit nobody may eat and a two-way mirror the size of a wall. Children are not permitted, for safety. Employees play them instead.

locations.description: A vast padded test range under floodlights, where toys are proven safe by testing them on everything else. The crash-test dummies wear party hats.
